properties.bedrock_type: Lower Carboniferous sedimentary strata and volcanic intrusions (Gullane Formation / Arthur's Seat Volcanic Formation)
properties.mineralogy: Craigleith and Hailes sandstone, basaltic dolerite, glaciated alluvial deposits of the former Nor' Loch basin
properties.drainage: Engineered subsurface railway culverts and drainage network underlying Waverley Valley

properties.primary_surfacing: Asphalt roadbed along Waverley Bridge, sandstone kerbstones, reinforced concrete balustrades, steel railway tracks, ballast bed
properties.wear_characteristics: Rail ballast oil-staining, polished steel rails, textured vehicular asphalt with painted white road lines
properties.micro_grading: Elevated bridge span crossing the excavated glacial valley cutting of Waverley Station

properties.groundcover: Steep landscaped valley embankment grasses and dense herbaceous border of East Princes Street Gardens

properties.primary_building_typology: Victorian railway terminal infrastructure and Old Town / New Town stone tenements

structures.name: Waverley Station Glazed Canopy Roof
structures.roof_geometry: Multi-span ridge-and-furrow glazed roof with wrought iron trusses
structures.facade_material: Painted structural iron framing, translucent industrial wired glass panels, lead flashing
structures.weathering_patina: Industrial particulate deposition, rain streaking across glass ridges, minor corrosion on structural truss seams

structures.name: Waverley Bridge Parcel Office / Station Building
structures.roof_geometry: Flat bituminous felt roof with parapet perimeter
structures.facade_material: Craigleith ashlar sandstone with rusticated basement arches and dressed architraves
structures.weathering_patina: Pronounced historical atmospheric coal-smoke crusting and dark soot staining in reveals and undercuts

structures.name: Market Street North Tenement Block (Former Gas Showrooms / Offices)
structures.facade_material: Pale ashlar sandstone facade with concrete rear structural framing and brick infill
structures.weathering_patina: Mineral efflorescence, light airborne grime, uniform grey-buff tone

structures.name: Market Street & Cockburn Street Historic Tenements
structures.roof_geometry: Steep Scottish vernacular pitched roofs with stepped crowstep gables, dormers, and multiple ashlar chimney stacks
structures.facade_material: Dark Craigleith and Hailes coursed rubble and ashlar sandstone, Ballachulish slate roofs
structures.weathering_patina: Heavy, centuries-old carbon crusting, deep black soot deposits in stone recesses, natural differential weathering of sandstone blocks

structures.name: Waverley Bridge Span
structures.facade_material: Riveted steel plate girders, cast-iron parapets, ashlar stone bridge abutments
structures.weathering_patina: Atmospheric grime, mineral leaching down abutment joints

properties.lighting_condition: Crisp temperate daylight with subtle North Sea coastal clarity, casting sharp structural shadows
